profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am passionate about people and problem-solving! I have experience adding value to companies at various stages through both writing code and leading engineers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Built CI/CD infrastructure from the ground up, automating Unity builds and eliminating a fully manual process
* Developed a proprietary metric to assess student speaking ability, leading the feature from initial data development in Python to full-stack implementation in the company portal
* Improved product team workflow and communication by applying Agile principles to task management software
* Built interactive learning games in Unity, working with our curriculum and product designers to create an enriching experience

positions.title: Group Engineering Manager
positions.description:
* Managed 3 full stack teams of developers in a persona-focused group
* Led our internship program, including hiring our 2023 class of summer interns
* Listened to employee feedback, mitigated frustration around company changes
* Implemented process changes on a struggling team, leading to improved morale/communication and ultimately successful project delivery
* Performed 1:1s with team members
* Guided individuals in pursuing and reaching their professional goals

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Led a project that involved coordinating efforts among web, iOS, and Android developers and researching the architecture of all three platforms
* Built several new features for our web platform with my team
* Mentored two junior developers as they began their careers at SimpleNexus

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed onboarding app for Windows 11
* Worked with other teams to embed content from different apps into our product
* Oversaw quality of Windows onboarding experience by leading automated testing efforts

positions.title: Team Lead and Engineer
positions.description:
* Directed team responsible for improving user experience for Real Estate Agents
* Coordinated with product manager to plan future work for the team
* Led weekly meetings to prioritize and assign work to team members
* Performed 1:1s with team members

positions.title: Full Stack iOS Engineer
positions.description:
* Built iOS experience for the industry's first mobile rate-locking functionality 
* Added innovative new features to improve user experience and increase productivity for over 20,000 Loan Officers 
* Documented and trained on in-house iOS build system  
* Refactored calls to legacy REST endpoints to use GraphQL
* Actively problem solved fixing bugs for support on mobile and backend

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Created English language-learning software for children in foreign countries
* Built & launched the flagship app in Unity and C# with a team of developers
* Exceeded expectations of multi-national clients associated with continual app releases and upgrades

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Created user-friendly, responsive online storefronts for several auxiliary services
* Implemented these improvements in HTML and CSS

volunteerExperiences.description:
* Guided incoming female Computer Science freshmen as they began the program, answering questions and assisting them in planning their class schedules
* Helped mentees feel comfortable entering a challenging major by providing support and encouragement
